inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Routines Maintained: It was determined that staff failed to maintain regular diapering routines, resulting in a child going the entire day without a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Routines Maintained (26 TAC §746.2501(1))

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs: It was determined that staff in the school age classroom were not following the scheduled activity plan which led to a lack of structure that contributed to running and physical altercations in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs (26 TAC §746.2201)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Due to the number of deficiencies identified during the investigation, it is determined that the Director is not ensuring the operation remains in compliance with minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not report this incident to CCR as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: The operation was aware of the victim's ability to wander and climb, jump from shelves; however, no measures were implemented to prevent these behaviors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: The caregivers were not aware of which staff member was responsible for supervising the victim when he was able to wander out of the building unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director was unable to provide the requested documentation to DFPS upon request at the time of inspection
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not complete an incident report for the victim, who wandered out of the building unsupervised and was found by a construction worker.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: In a caregiver interview, the caregiver admitted to restraining a child in a chair to prevent them from running around the classroom and to allow the caregiver to regain control of the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: The caregiver did not buy ice cream for two of the ten children that went on the field trip because they were misbehaving.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required: One caregiver did not have training in administering medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two caregivers did not have current CPR/First Aid training available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There was no documentation of monthly checks of the fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation did not have documentation showing that severe weather and lock down drills are being completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: The operation had a carbon monoxide detector installed but it was not in working condition.  (Note;  The director submitted a work order during the inspection and the detector was repaired).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: There was no documentation of monthly testing of the smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required: One caregiver did not have training in administering medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not complete the employees who left employment survey timely.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation did not have a current gas inspection available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The caregiver files were not avai;able for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: A caregiver did not respond promptly to a child that was injured and required medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: One Seat Belt Per Person: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: One Seat Belt Per Person (26 TAC §746.5613)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This was evaluated during a DFPS investigation and found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child's file did not include current immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Two caregivers did not have a current first aid certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Four child's files did not have the health statement singed by a physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Two caregivers did not have a current CPR certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Two children under the age of two were in a room with a television on.  This was corrected at inspection when the children were moved out of the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation did not have a current gas leak inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: 11/2/2022- The wooden barrier around the toddler playground still had exposed nails and rotten wood.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Throughout the operation, there were areas that had chipped paint that could be flaked off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: On the toddler playground the wooden frame around the area had exposed nails and rotten wood.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A child was unsupervised on the playground for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director was unable to provide documentation for attendance at the operation on 2/14/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: Based on information obtained during the investigation, it was determined a staff member failed to properly account for all children during transition from the playground to the classroom.  A child was left on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver failed to follow the operation's policies and procedures for a counting for children during transition from the playground to the classroom.    A child was left unsupervised on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
